datasets.title: Burundi Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Burundi Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/burundi_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Burundi to assess acute food insecurity conditions and classify geographic areas using the IPC framework. Survey results were spatially encoded as GeoJSON/KML features with IPC phase classifications, collection dates, and scenario information for 2020.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity and affected populations across geographic areas.
